[[File:BoardGameRMQ-SWGP.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] and a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] playing a board game]]
A '''board game''' was any game played with pieces on a flat surface. Some board games, such as [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]], utilized holographic pieces,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> while others, such as [[Chess/Legends|chess]], used physical pieces.<ref name="HSE">[[Han Solo at Stars' End (comic strip)|''Han Solo at Stars' End'' comic]]</ref> The [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] played board games on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] just prior to the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]].<ref name="AAC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>
